description: Top-class filly Venetian Sun is set to be offered at the Tattersalls December Mares Sale by owners Tony Bloom and Ian McAleavy.

description: The bay colt (Hip 242) is a half brother to grade 1 winner and sire Mo Town and graded-placed stakes winner Justique. He was bred by John Gunther with Tanya Gunther's Eurowest Bloodstock and sold by the Gunthers' Glennwood Farm.

description: Jockey Florent Geroux remained in the intensive care unit through the evening of Sept. 14 at University of Louisville Hospital following a Sept. 10 spill at Churchill Downs, agent Matt Nakataini posted on social media.

description: The Aiken Thoroughbred Racing Hall of Fame & Museum hosts an exhibit about the Puerto Rican Racing Academy through Oct. 4 in celebration of Latino Heritage Month.

description: Graded stakes winners Banishing and Chunk of Gold will bypass the Sept. 18 Jockey Club Gold Cup (G1) in favor of stakes races later this month at Churchill Downs.

description: Days after his victory in the Sept. 12 Woodbine Mile Stakes (G1T), Notable Speech has advanced from 18th to eighth place in the National Thoroughbred Racing Association's Top Thoroughbred Poll.

description: Well-bred 2-year-olds Coach Pope and Endrush are BloodHorse Maiden Watch Hot Prospects after notching swift maiden victories at Churchill Downs.

description: Dollars & Sense with Frank Angst looks at some of the legal arguments being offered and that we'll hear as courts define the laws and regulation of prediction markets.

description: Hip 238 is the first foal out of Goodnight Olive. And just as there was ample anticipation for his birth, there might be even more for his appearance in the sales ring.

description: On the debut episode of BH In Session: Keeneland September, Louie Rabaut recaps a successful opening day of the Keeneland September Yearling Sale and speaks with several of the day's players.

description: The Keeneland September Yearling Sale saw increases across nearly all metrics compared to last year's corresponding session with 104 horses selling for $73,550,000, including private sales.

description: Taylor Made Stallions' marquee sire Not This Time, who currently sits atop the general sires list, had a spectacular opening day at the Keeneland September Yearling Sale Sept. 14.

description: Owner/breeder Mike Repole accuses agents of price manipulation on a filly offered at last year's Keeneland September Yearling Sale. Determined Stud said it bought the filly back because she did not bring the desired price and sold her privately.

title_en: Gun Runner Yearling Provides Thrill for Darby Dan Farm
description: The desire to secure the rights to Gun Runner's progeny continues at Keeneland, but the $2.3 million price tag for Hip 116 carried its own acclaim for consignor Darby Dan Farm.

title_en: Day 1 Recap of Keeneland September Yearling Sale
description: Shannon Arvin and Tony Lacy of Keeneland recap the opening session of the Keeneland September Sale.

title_en: Devall, Breeder of Havnameltdown, Dies at 57
description: Katherine Devall, breeder of a pair of graded stakes winners, died Sept. 3 in Paintsville, Ky. The former resident of Lexington and Florida was 57.

description: FOX's planned coverage of the Jockey Club Gold Cup Stakes (G1) from the new Belmont Park is one of the highlights of this week's racing coverage on TV, radio, streaming.

description: On the Sept. 14 episode of BloodHorse Monday: Assistant trainer Nic Lynch joins to discuss Manuka Honey's victory in the Pocahontas (G3) and team Lynch's successful year. We look back at Salahudin's Iroquois (G3) win and ahead to Belmont Park.

title_en: Gun Runner Strikes Again at Keeneland With $2.8M Colt
description: RTM Racing lands the fourth seven-figure Gun Runner yearling through Hip 84 during the Sept. 14 opening session of the Keeneland September Yearling Sale.

title_en: TripAdvisor Adds Animal Welfare Warning for Racetracks
description: A decision by TripAdvisor to prevent the sale of tickets and experiences associated with live horse racing events on its platforms has been called "surprising and troubling" by the British Horseracing Authority.

title_en: Gun Runner Half to Justify Rockets to $1.9M
description: Winchell Thoroughbreds, which raced Gun Runner with Three Chimneys Farm, bought the colt (Hip 47) from Glennwood Farm.

description: Scandinavia may or may not be suffering from the dreaded Ballydoyle bug but the very best invariably find a way to win even if they aren't at their best, and there was a strong hint of that as he got the job done in the Irish St Leger (G1).

title_en: Folsom Blues Impresses in O'Brien National Triumph
description: Folsom Blues produced a stunning performance in the Sept. 13 Vincent O'Brien National Stakes (G1) at the Curragh, charging 6 lengths clear of Monogram to seal a one-two for Joseph O'Brien.

title_en: Sun Goddess Dominates Foes in Moyglare Stud
description: Moments after Aidan O'Brien went public about a low-grade infection that has been impacting some of his horses' performances in recent months, Sun Goddess belied any concerns with another emphatic display in the Sept. 13 Moyglare Stud Stakes (G1).

description: Comanche Brave backed up his stylish success in the July Cup (G1) at Newmarket with an even silkier performance in the Flying Five Stakes (G1) Sept. 13 at the Curragh, bursting clear for a decisive victory over American Affair.

title_en: Sheza Alibi Magnificent in Makybe Diva Victory
description: Sheza Alibi showed she was well and truly on the path to greatness when she stormed to a breathtakingly dominant victory in the Sept. 12 Makybe Diva Stakes (G1).

title_en: Splendora Rolls to Easy Locust Grove Victory
description: Splendora turned what was a compelling matchup into a runaway, coasting to a 5 1/4-length victory in the $326,000 Locust Grove Stakes (G2) for fillies and mares Sept. 12 at Churchill Downs.

title_en: After Slow Start, Salahudin Storms Home in Iroquois
description: Salahudin and Manuka Honey remain unbeaten with victories in the Iroquois Stakes (G3) and Pocahontas Stakes (G3), respectively, as the roads to the Kentucky Derby and Kentucky Oaks begin.

description: Kerry's Kiss broke on top and was never threatened thereafter in the $187,750 Princess Rooney Stakes (G3) Sept. 12 at Gulfstream Park, while providing trainer Saffie Joseph Jr. with his fourth consecutive victory in the 7-furlong stakes.

title_en: Notable Speech Grabs Second Consecutive Woodbine Mile
description: Notable Speech had to fight his way through a hole into the stretch, but William Buick guided the 5-year-old past Deterministic inside the final furlong to win the Woodbine Mile Stakes (G1T) Sept. 12 at Woodbine.

title_en: Gimme a Nother Gets Neck Win in E. P. Taylor
description: Undefeated in her native South Africa, Gimme a Nother is crafting herself a terrific resume in North America as evidenced by her latest win here, the Sept. 12 E. P. Taylor Stakes (G1T) at Woodbine.

description: A day laced with historical significance for women in racing ended with Jessica Harrington reminding everyone of her exquisite talents by masterminding a dramatic 50-1 Irish Champion Stakes (G1) coup with Hotazhell Sept. 12 at Leopardstown.

title_en: Sun Goddess Seeks to Carry Strong Form to Moyglare
description: Sun Goddess has arguably been the most outstanding 2-year-old filly this season and she rocks up to the Sept. 13 Moyglare Stud Stakes (G1) on the back of a stunning triumph in a sales race at York Racecourse's Ebor meeting.
